summary: WonderCMS is a flat-file content management system written in PHP. It allows you to publish and manage website content without needing a traditional database engine, storing data directly in files instead.
goodFor: It suits minimalist websites, single-page sites, or personal blogs where you want to avoid the administrative overhead of a database-backed CMS.
watchOut: The project has low maintenance activity, which may introduce security risks or unpatched bugs over time. It also lacks the extensive plugin ecosystem found in larger alternatives.
deployNotes: Since it runs on PHP, you will typically need a standard web server like Nginx or Apache with a PHP runtime, and persistent storage for the file-based backend data.
